meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 安装后，它会自动在会话开始和用户提交消息时注入静态项目规则，并在 Codex 执行 apply_patch 后注入文件特定的规则。支持从多种规则文件读取，还会注入动态输出作为额外上下文，但不会重写工具输出。
howto.when: 当你询问 Codex Rules 的行为机制、项目规则注入方式、支持的规则文件位置、匹配逻辑或环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: 它会列出 CONTEXT.md 等受支持的文件路径。

say.text: 如何用环境变量禁用 Codex Rules？
动态规则输出会被怎么处理？
say.note: 它会解释动态输出会按会话去重且不重写工具结果。

howto.what_en: When enabled, it automatically injects static project rules on session start and user prompt submit, and file-specific rules after Codex apply_patch. It reads from multiple supported rule file locations and injects deduplicated dynamic output as extra context without rewriting tool output.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask about Codex Rules behavior, project rule injection, supported rule file locations, matching logic, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: It lists supported paths like CONTEXT.md.

say_en.text: How do I disable Codex Rules with an env variable?
What happens to dynamic rule output?
say_en.note: It clarifies deduplication and no rewrite.
